Title: Power of All vs "no cost is paid" (LSJ)

Messages.Author: Stone
Messages.Body:
Power of All does not have the "no cost is paid" text most card-cancellers
have. Does this mean the cost is actually paid, just like the cost of Frenzy
cards cancelled by Reflex cards is still paid ? Should be yes.
thanks
Stone

Name: Power of All

[TR:C]

Cardtype: Reaction

Cost: 2 blood

Requires a ready anarch.

Tap this anarch and one other untapped ready anarch you control to cancel a
library card as it is played. Usable even if there is no action. Not usable
during your own turn.

Artist: Eric Deschamps
